name: Eagle Crest
label: Eagle Crest
about_prose: Eagle Crest is a 1,700-acre destination resort community 6 miles west of downtown Redmond on Cline Falls Road, at 3,622 feet along the east slopes of Cline Buttes and the Deschutes River canyon. It is one of eight official destination resorts under Oregon's land-use program. Established in 1985, it was developed in phases over three decades, adding gated residential enclaves and three golf courses.

The resort operates three 18-hole courses open to residents and guests. The Resort Course (6,672 yards, par 72), designed by Gene Mason, runs along the Deschutes River canyon rim. The Ridge Course (6,927 yards, par 72) by John Thronson threads through native juniper and has hosted the Oregon Open. The Challenge Course (4,160 yards, par 63) is a quicker executive layout.

Residential areas run under the Eagle Crest Master Association and, separately, The Ridge at Eagle Crest HOA. The Lodge at Eagle Crest holds 100 hotel rooms and 80 condominium units alongside a 10,000-square-foot conference center. Three sports centers, Resort, Ridge, and Lakeside, provide year-round recreation. The community sits 16 miles from Bend and 14 miles from Smith Rock State Park.

amenities.name: Resort Course
amenities.description: Par-72 course playing 6,672 yards, designed by Gene Mason, following the Deschutes River canyon rim with holes perched above the river.

amenities.name: Ridge Course
amenities.description: Par-72 course playing 6,927 yards by John Thronson through native juniper forest. Host of the Oregon Open in 2006 and 2023.

amenities.name: Challenge Course
amenities.description: Par-63 executive course playing 4,160 yards, with four tee boxes per hole and a round of roughly three hours.

amenities.name: Resort Sports Center
amenities.description: Two indoor and two outdoor tennis courts, three racquetball courts, an outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna, fitness center, and game room.

amenities.name: Ridge Sports Center
amenities.description: Indoor lap pool, hot tub, wading pool, Cybex fitness center, basketball, pickleball, and volleyball courts.

amenities.name: Lakeside Sports Center
amenities.description: Outdoor infinity-edge pool, splash park, kiddie pool, outdoor basketball, four pickleball courts, and a fitness center.

amenities.name: Trails Network
amenities.description: Over 11 miles of paved paths plus a 1.5-mile Deschutes River trail, with access to river rafting and water sports.

amenities.name: The Spa at Eagle Crest
amenities.description: Day spa inside the Ridge Sports Center offering massage, facials, body treatments, and nail care using organic skincare lines.

amenities.name: Niblick and Greene's
amenities.description: Full-service restaurant at the resort with dinner service and live music, alongside the Aerie, Silverleaf, and Greenside cafes.

amenities.name: The Lodge and Conference Center
amenities.description: 100-room hotel with 80 condominium units and 10,000 square feet of meeting space, including a ballroom seating up to 360.

drive_times.note: Roberts Field, about 7.8 miles by road

course_specs.summary: Three 18-hole courses: Resort (par 72, 6,672 yds, Gene Mason), Ridge (par 72, 6,927 yds, John Thronson, host of the Oregon Open), and Challenge (par 63, 4,160 yds). An 18-hole live-turf putting course is also on site.
